query: I have a 56‑year‑old man to evaluate. Among male Medicare patients aged 51–61 admitted via the ED with principal acute pancreatitis, what is the 30‑day readmission rate? Report median index LOS for readmitted vs non‑readmitted and percent stays >9 days.
